character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A monstrous four-legged deep-blue shark beast, side view predatory prowling animation. Sleek pointed shark head, wide gaping jaw packed with triangular jagged teeth, black pupil-less eyes, gills flaring along the neck, prominent dorsal fin on back. Dark navy-blue skin covered in pale jagged bite scars, heavy muscular torso supported by four beastly legs, thick shark tail swishing rhythmically. Wearing classic all-white low-top leather sneakers (Air Force 1 style) on all four paws, pacing forward in a heavy low stalking gait, no weapon. Clean bold outline, limited palette, chibi 3-head proportions.
